title: rubus niveus var. pedunculosus
intro: Rubus niveus var. pedunculosus, commonly known as the White Himalayan Raspberry, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing oxidative stress, alleviating pain, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Rubus niveus var. pedunculosus include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal, anti-flatulent, and anti-ulcer agent, as well as its potential to exert antioxidant and anti-hyperglycemic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
